text:
anya: Heads-up: console shows a big p99 jump for GET /v1/generate when I filter by region=eu-central. p50/p95 look normal. Anyone seen region-only percentile oddities recently?

rafa: Are you looking at the dashboard panel or the raw analytics endpoint?

anya: Dashboard panel. No infra events in that time window.

liam: Common cause = aggregation mode switching based on sample volume. We do tdigest -> histogram -> raw-sample depending on counts. @ops-bot what are the cutoffs now?

ops-bot: rollup modes: tdigest if count >= 12k, histogram if 1k <= count < 12k, raw samples if count < 1k. (see telemetry/rollups.md)

rafa: If the panel switched to histogram, bucket granularity can amplify a few large values. What was the sample_count for your filter?

anya: dropped from ~150k globally to ~4.5k for the eu-central slice.

liam: 4.5k sits in histogram range. Histograms use 100ms buckets for this dataset; a few 1.2s-1.9s fallback requests will push the top bucket.

zoe: Maybe the slice is including route fallbacks. Can you re-run grouping by route_origin? Quick query suggestion:
```
SELECT minute, count(*) AS n, pctl(0.99, latency_ms) AS p99, route_origin
FROM requests
WHERE region='eu-central' AND endpoint='/v1/generate'
GROUP BY minute, route_origin
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 30;
```

anya: ran it. p99 spikes map to route_origin='fallback' rows. fallback is ~0.5-1% of the slice but those rows have latencies ~1.3s-2.0s.

rafa: That matches histogram sensitivity. Two quick UX fixes: show provenance (tdigest/histogram/raw) and sample_count on the panel value. Also show top contributing tag (like route_origin).

liam: Agreed. Longer-term: adjust blending so we don't compute p99 across mixed origins without indicating dominance. Options: require minimum tail sample count threshold before surfacing p99, or compute weighted-percentile-per-origin and then aggregate. Both need infra work.

zoe: Also add a tooltip: "p99 provenance: histogram (bucket=100ms), sample_count=4500, dominant_origin=fallback (0.8%)." That is low-effort and helps on-call interpretation.

anya: I'll file a console bug with screenshots + the analytics queries. tagging @rafa @liam for follow-up.

rafa: Thanks. One more: can we make the panel auto-suggest a "split by route_origin" button when provenance is histogram? Could be helpful.

liam: Good idea. I'll add it to the console backlog item. For now, show provenance + counts.

anya: ticket created: CONSOLE-3489, attaching queries and the raw histogram bucket counts. Closing this thread, thanks all :raised_hands:
